Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Ugh... where am I?

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: The ship's wrecked, but I'm alive. I actually made it.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: This place is beautiful. The grass chimes when the wind moves through it. It's so peaceful here.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Maybe whoever attacked Zimra never found this planet. Maybe the others landed somewhere like this too.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The ground shook. Shapes came pouring over the hill.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: No... not here too! How did they find me?

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Agh! There are too many of them!

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Out of nowhere, a burst of white light tore through them. The creatures scattered.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Stay down! ...There. They're gone. For now.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Who... who are you?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Elyra. I live on Auvora. Well, in the parts of it that are still quiet.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: You're lucky. Most people they surround don't get back up. What's your name?

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Tehilo. I'm from Zimra. Or I was. They attacked us too.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Those dots in the sky…

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: He looks up. For a moment, the glow reflects in his eyes. A memory flashes across his mind: the same strange pattern hanging over Zimra before the attack.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: I saw them before Zimra was attacked. What could they mean?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Those aren’t dots. It’s sheet music.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Sheet music? I’ve heard about it. It’s apparently a way to write down music.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Never learnt it, though.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Fortunately for you, I have. Mostly.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: “Mostly” is reassuring!

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: I’ve decoded enough to know how the system works. See these five lines? That’s the stave. The higher a note sits on it, the higher the pitch.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: This is G. The curl of the treble clef circles that line, which is how you know where G belongs.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: This one with the line through it at the bottom is Middle C.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: This one with the line through it at the bottom is Middle C.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Exactly. See the little line through it? That’s a ledger line. It lets us write notes outside the main stave.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: So the lines just keep going when you run out of room?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: More or less.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: All right. So I have to memorise the note for every single position?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Not every single one. Notes move up and down the stave in order. If you know one note, you can work out the notes around it.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: You make that sound easy.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: It becomes easier with practice.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: A low rumble interrupts them. The glowing lines overhead flicker. Several hostile notes begin to peel away from the distant musical pattern, descending toward the ground.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Please tell me those are friendly.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: They are very much not friendly.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Uh oh.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: “Uh oh” what?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: That explosion earlier may have fried the focusing crystal in my staff.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: You caused an explosion?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: I caused a controlled explosion. The staff malfunction was an unexpected side effect.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: And you can’t fix it?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Not while those things are trying to turn us into musical notation.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: So you’re saying I have to fight them?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: That's pretty much what I'm saying, yeah.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Why me?!

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Uh, hello? Because there are enemies, I don’t have a weapon, and you’re standing right there. Keep up.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: I’ve been here five minutes! How am I supposed to figure all this out on my first try

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Don’t panic. The attacks around here are relatively weak. You should have enough time to learn what the notes mean.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: “Should”?

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Would you prefer I lie to you?

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Right. Read the music. Don’t get hit. Got it.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: Something like that.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: You could sound a little more encouraging.

Lines.Speaker: Elyra
Lines.Text: YOU could try not getting hit...
